content.title: How to watch Iowa vs. Illinois men’s basketball: Elite Eight TV channel and streaming options for March 28
content.text: The No. 3 seed Illinois Fighting Illini (27-8, 15-5 Big Ten) and No. 9 seed Iowa Hawkeyes (24-12, 10-10 Big Ten) will face off for a spot in the NCAA Tournament Final Four on Saturday at Toyota Center, starting at 6:09 p.m. ET.How to watch Iowa Hawkeyes vs. Illinois Fighting Illini Venue: Toyota Center Time: 6:09 p.m. ET TV: TBS Watching in person? It puts up 84.2 points per game (21st in college basketball) and gives up 69.0 per contest (56th in college basketball). It is shooting 35.1% from deep (111th in college basketball) while allowing opponents to shoot 30.9%. Iowa is outscoring opponents by 8.9 points per game, with a +318 scoring differential overall. It puts up 75.0 points per game (200th in college basketball) and gives up 66.1 per outing (16th in college basketball). Iowa makes 8.1 three-pointers per game (149th in college basketball) while shooting 35.4% from deep (96th in college basketball). It is making 1.4 more threes than its opponents, who drain 6.7 per game at 33.6%.
